b2b7a52.text: Create an “Endless Aisle” Use a small form factor screen to create an endless aisle in which customers can go deeper and deeper into a product line. Incorporate demonstration videos to show customers how to use a product and how multiple products can work together.

f1e5315.text: Increase Sales Customers are more likely to buy something if they see a digital sign for it than if they don’t. Using your collected sales data, determine the best marketing messages to display and change them throughout the day as your customers change.

418371c.text: Have Fun and Get Creative Interactive touch screen displays give you full creative control to let the imagination of your customers run wild. 08d5396.text: Let Customers Ignore the Things They Don’t Care About Another important aspect of an interactive merchandise display is that it lets customers focus only on the things that matter to them when they’re making a buying decision. This sort of personalized shopping experience will separate you from your competitors and will encourage your customers to keep coming back.

21614472.text: Speed Monitoring This system helps traffic police by digitizing the speed monitoring process. Speed limit offenders are recorded by the cameras and receive their tickets complete with their plates’ image and their speed when the picture was taken.

2d1df7c1.text: Components The software is simple and can easily be accessed on any computer. Image decoding techniques enhance pictures taken, after which optical character recognition separates individual characters. Some of the major components in ANPR systems include cameras, software, frame grabbers, and triggers.

662ce087.text: Technology ANPR camera systems are tailored to the specific country of use, although a few variants can be used internationally. They use optical character recognition software to decipher coded characters from the captured images.

b19f5d6.text: Algorithms The software combines seven different algorithms to function fully. The algorithms find the plates on the car, identify orientation and font size, adjust contrast and light, differentiate individual characters, arrange them according to the country’s rules, and give final output as a single image.
